profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, and trades under the ticker DT. Its site describes it as an observability platform built for the age of AI, combining observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform. The company says its platform is intended to help organizations innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes, and it describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader.

The site states that the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. It quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, on that point, and includes a customer statement that Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The company's record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It is recorded as having exposure in Massachusetts, with a count of 191.
